title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: Subtropical saltmarshes are changing rapidly in response to climate-driven sea level rise and shifting species ranges. New research on Florida's northeastern coast experimentally tests how sediment amendments that restore elevational losses in saltmarshes influence alternative plant communities. Pictured are study authors Britney Hay and Adam Hymel. Full details are available in the article by Hay et al., https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2664.70301.
